data.notes: It catches all three must-haves: the win covers memberships only with the front desks still on Global, Greg's decision rests on recovery shown in their own renewal data, and front-desk proof inside the studio software is the gap. It also handles the skipped words question correctly by saying the phrase came from earlier in the call. Minor misses: the decider action is tied to A4, an average-based stat that clashes with its own 'not averages' point, and the competitor action skips the front-desk hardware defence and has no S2 link.
